headline: EPS climbs sharply year-over-year
summary_short: Murata Manufacturing reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥44.71, up 66.6% y/y and 6.0% q/q.
summary_long: EPS of ¥44.71 rose 66.6% year-over-year from ¥26.83 and 6.0% sequentially from ¥42.17 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
